note: This increment extracts the PE section parser for budget testing and adds MSF block-size, procedure-kind, module-budget, spelling and 64MiB tests. PDB symbol semantics are unchanged.
covered: classic MSF 7 files up to 64MiB are accepted and larger inputs are rejected
block sizes 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096 are accepted; a truncated geometry is rejected
MSF geometry, directory, block map and every referenced stream are validated before reading
at most 4096 streams, 4096 modules, 512 PE sections, 200000 procedures and 1000000 CodeView records are enforced
GUID and age come from stream 1, modules from DBI stream 3 and section headers from optional-debug-header slot 5
S_GPROC32, S_LPROC32, both _ID forms and both DPC forms are extracted from module symbol streams
one-based executable PE sections convert procedure offsets through the section virtual address and retain the declared code size
the embedded GUID+age keys the symbols and a disagreeing multipart Debug ID makes the PDB ineligible
the original procedure spelling, including spaces and punctuation, is preserved
a PDB is accepted as a regular ZIP, TAR or TAR.GZ member
malformed MSF, CodeView, inline and C13 inputs return no partial symbols
limits: Legacy/Portable PDB and complete native unwinding remain outside this slice.
No final image, public CI or external SDK crash was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
